summary: Implementation plan for the Speed 5G Network Wi-Fi ISP Portal featuring email/password auth (first user becomes admin), customer plan selection and support tickets, admin plan/customer/support management, and the Network & Router Operations dashboard (visual network topology map, 24-hour green/red uptime block graph, connected devices table with speed-limit sliders and disconnect actions, router reboot controls with weekly auto-reboot schedule, and 9 AM Nairobi payment reminder + 5-minute router check background jobs) with zero demo data.
